text:
Aisha (PM): Quick note from today's design review — the in-product docs panel on the Model routes shows 'Model tag' in the header but the docs link points to 'model-version' content. Users are getting confused when they try to pin versions.

Rafael (Docs): Oof, yeah I noticed that too while triaging a support ticket. Docs use 'model version' everywhere, but the console copy uses 'tag' in the panel and the anchor ID is #model-version.

Dan (Design): I think we should pick one term and be explicit. Prefer 'model version' because it's more standard. We should also change the small pill label in the panel to 'Version' (short) and add an explanatory tooltip.

Marta (Eng): Technically trivial to change the label, but need to confirm we don't break analytics events or the deep-linking UX. The panel's docs link currently appends #model-version — if we change the visible text only, no problem. If we change the anchor, we need a redirect.

Aisha (PM): Good point. Rafael, can you add stable anchor IDs for the docs and a short redirect map? We want backward-compatible links. Also can we add a small inline link in the panel that goes directly to the 'pinning' subsection?

Rafael (Docs): Yep, I can add explicit anchors and synonyms. Proposal: keep anchors as #model-version and add an alias anchor #model-tag that redirects via HTML meta refresh or server rewrite. I'll also add a short note in the docs header: "console label: Version (aka model tag)".

Dan (Design): For accessibility: ensure the tooltip is reachable by keyboard and its aria-describedby points to the tooltip content. Also the inline link should have a descriptive label like "Learn how to pin a model version" instead of just "docs".

Marta (Eng): Implementation plan: (1) change UI label to "Version" in next patch, (2) add inline link text and aria-label, (3) Rafael deploys anchor aliases. For deep-link redirects we'll add a small nginx rule mapping /docs/*#model-tag -> /docs/*#model-version if needed.

Aisha (PM): Timeline? We want this in the next minor release. Any blockers?

Rafael (Docs): I'll open a docs PR tonight with anchors and the header note. ETA review 24h.

Marta (Eng): I'll pair with @Rafael for the redirect snippet and create a tiny feature branch for the UI label change. No infra blockers.

Dan (Design): I'll upload a quick screenshot + tooltip copy variants in Figma. Two options: short copy vs explanatory microcopy. Will put both with accessibility notes.

ConsoleBot: deploy-checklist: docs-pr: open, ui-flag: feature-branch-created, qa: needs-test-case (pinning deep links).

Aisha (PM): Awesome. One more ask — can we add a one-line cross-link in the top of the console docs panel to the docs glossary where we define "version / tag / variant"? Helps reduce future confusion.

Rafael (Docs): Will do. Adding a glossary anchor and a single-sentence definition is quick. I'll also add search aliases for "tag" and "variant" so in-app search surfaces the right page.

Marta (Eng): I'll add an e2e test that follows the inline link and verifies landing at #pinning and that the keyboard focus lands on the H2.

Dan (Design): Sounds good. :thumbsup: Anything else?

Aisha (PM): No, that's it. Thanks team — can we reconvene after PR reviews?
